mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, title, content, related_id, is_read, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{relatedId}, #{isRead}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notifications WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_settings (user_id, like_notification, comment_notification, follow_notification, system_notification, video_notification) VALUES (#{userId}, #{likeNotification}, #{commentNotification}, #{followNotification}, #{systemNotification}, #{videoNotification}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE like_notification = #{likeNotification}, comment_notification = #{commentNotification}, follow_notification = #{followNotification}, system_notification = #{systemNotification}, video_notification = #{videoNotification}
